name: Kamimachi Shoujo to Tome Otoko ~Iede Musume ni Tanezuke Chuu~
original_name: 神待ち少女と泊め男 ～家出むすめに種付け中～
source: Kunihiko is a pervert making a living by working part time at a suspicious old book store. Through an acquaintance, he gets to know the existence of "God-Waiting-Girl". They are runaway schoolgirl seeking for food and place to live from men online. Kunihiko decides to become "God" and offer helps in exchange for their body.
translation: 邦彦是一名变态，靠在一家可疑的旧书店打工为生。通过熟人，他知道了“侍神少女”的存在。她们是离家出走的女学生，在网上向男人寻求食物和住处。国彦决定成为“神”并提供帮助以换取他们的身体。
